ei.title: Full Data Is More Reusable than Sample in Digital Era
ei.subject: 11월_2023 고2 모의고사
ei.lesson: Full Data Is More Reusable than Sample in Digital Era

fullPassage:
For a long time, random sampling was a good shortcut. It made analysis of large data problems possible in the pre-digital era.

(A) There is no need to focus at the beginning, since collecting all the information makes it possible to do that afterwards. Because rays from the entire light field are included, it is closer to all the data. As a result, the information is more “reuseable” than ordinary pictures, where the photographer has to decide what to focus on before she presses the shutter.

(B) But much as converting a digital image or song into a smaller file results in loss of data, information is lost when sampling. Having the full (or close to the full) dataset provides a lot more freedom to explore, to look at the data from different angles or to look closer at certain aspects of it.

(C) A fitting example may be the light-field camera, which captures not just a single plane of light, as with conventional cameras, but rays from the entire light field, some 11 million of them. The photographers can decide later which element of an image to focus on in the digital file.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A) shortcut(지름길) — 무작위 표본 추출이 좋은 지름길이었다는 의미, (B) freedom(자유) — 전체 데이터셋이 더 많은 자유를 제공, (C) fitting(적절한) — 적절한 예시
det.analysis:
❌ ① obstacle(장애물) — freedom(자유) — fitting(적절한): (A) obstacle은 shortcut의 반의어
✅ ② shortcut(지름길) — freedom(자유) — fitting(적절한): 원문 일치 ←정답
❌ ③ shortcut(지름길) — restriction(제한) — fitting(적절한): (B) restriction은 freedom의 반의어
❌ ④ shortcut(지름길) — freedom(자유) — misleading(오해하게 하는): (C) misleading은 fitting의 반의어

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

questions.passage:
For a long time, random sampling was a good ①<u>shortcut</u>. It made analysis of large data problems possible in the pre-digital era.

There is no need to focus at the beginning, since collecting all the information makes it possible to do that afterwards. Because rays from the entire light field are included, it is closer to all the data. As a result, the information is more “reuseable” than ②<u>ordinary</u> pictures, where the photographer has to decide what to focus on before she presses the shutter.

But much as converting a digital image or song into a smaller file results in loss of data, information is lost when sampling. Having the full (or close to the full) dataset provides a lot more ③<u>burden</u> to explore, to look at the data from different angles or to look closer at certain aspects of it.

A fitting example may be the light-field camera, which captures not just a single plane of light, as with ④<u>conventional</u> cameras, but rays from the entire light field, some 11 million of them. The photographers can decide later which element of an image to focus on in the digital file.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ① shortcut: 지름길 — 원문 일치
❌ ② ordinary: 보통의 — 원문 일치
✅ ③ burden: 부담 — 원문은 freedom(자유) ←정답
❌ ④ conventional: 전통적인 — 원문 일치

det.korean: conventional = following or in accordance with what is generally done or believed — 일반적으로 행해지거나 믿어지는 것에 따르는, 전통적인
det.analysis:
❌ ① digital: 디지털의 — 의미 불일치
❌ ② random: 무작위의 — 의미 불일치
✅ ③ conventional: 전통적인 — 영영풀이 일치 ←정답
❌ ④ fitting: 적절한 — 의미 불일치
det.tip: following what is generally done → conventional(전통적인)

questions.passage: Having the full dataset provides a lot more freedom to explore. The __________ (analyze) of large data problems was possible in the pre-digital era.

det.analysis:

questions.passage:
For a long time, random sampling was a good shortcut. It made analysis of large data problems possible in the pre-digital era.

There is no need to focus at the beginning, since collecting all the information makes it possible to do that __________. Because rays from the entire light field are included, it is closer to all the data. As a result, the information is more “reuseable” than ordinary pictures, where the photographer has to decide what to focus on before she presses the shutter.

But much as converting a digital image or song into a smaller file results in loss of data, information is lost when sampling. Having the full (or close to the full) dataset provides a lot more freedom to explore, to look at the data from different angles or to look closer at certain aspects of it.

A fitting example may be the light-field camera, which captures not just a single plane of light, as with conventional cameras, but rays from the entire light field, some 11 million of them. The photographers can decide later which element of an image to focus on in the digital file.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 빈칸: afterwards(나중에) — 모든 정보를 수집하면 나중에 초점을 맞출 수 있다는 문맥
det.analysis:
❌ ① beforehand: 사전에 — 문맥 반대
❌ ② rarely: 좀처럼 — 문맥 부적절
❌ ③ randomly: 무작위로 — 문맥 부적절
✅ ④ afterwards: 나중에 — 원문 일치 ←정답

questions.passage:
For a long time, random sampling was a good shortcut. It made analysis of large data problems possible in the pre-digital era.

There is no need to focus at the beginning, since collecting all the information makes it possible to do that afterwards. Because rays from the entire light field are included, it is closer to all the data. As a result, the information is more “reuseable” than ordinary pictures, where the photographer has to decide what to focus on before she presses the shutter.

But much as converting a digital image or song into a smaller file results in loss of data, information is lost when sampling. Having the full (or close to the full) dataset provides a lot more freedom to explore, to look at the data from different angles or to look closer at certain aspects of it.

A fitting example may be the light-field camera, which captures not just a single plane of light, as with conventional cameras, but rays from the entire light field, some 11 million of them. The photographers can decide later which __________ of an image to focus on in the digital file.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 빈칸: element(요소) — 사진작가가 나중에 이미지의 어떤 요소에 초점을 맞출지 결정한다는 문맥
det.analysis:
❌ ① surface: 표면 — 문맥 부적절
❌ ② frame: 프레임 — 문맥 부적절
✅ ③ element: 요소 — 원문 일치(which element of an image) ←정답
❌ ④ lens: 렌즈 — 문맥 부적절
det.tip: element = 요소 (which element of an image to focus on)
